source_signature.notes: Batch 4J skill 1/5, batch open. Owns determination of the EXTERNAL support reactions of a planar truss by treating the entire truss as a single rigid body, before any member analysis: the external free-body diagram carries only applied loads and support reactions, no member force appears on it however many members the truss has, and the internal member layout does not enter the reaction calculation at all. Solved by SigmaFx = 0, SigmaFy = 0, SigmaM = 0. Boundary: simple_truss_modeling (signed prerequisite) supplies the truss idealisation - pin joints, two-force members, loads at joints - cited not re-derived; beam_reactions (signed prerequisite) is the direct analogue, and the distinction this skill carries is that a truss is an assembly of many members yet still reduces to ONE rigid body for the external solve; rigid_body_equilibrium_2d, support_reactions_2d and support_reaction_modeling (signed) supply the equilibrium method and support-reaction modelling and are cited, not re-taught; method_of_joints and method_of_sections (batch siblings, positions 2 and 3) own MEMBER forces and will cite these reactions as their input, so this skill stops at Ax, Ay and Dy and computes no member force; zero_force_members and member_tension_compression_signs excluded. Worked example Operator-re-derived from the on-disk prompt: planar truss spanning 12 m, pin at A(0,0), roller at D(12,0); loads 12 kN down and 8 kN toward +x at joint B(4,3), and 24 kN down at joint C(8,3); nine members, none on the external FBD. SigmaM_A = 0: 12 Dy + [4(-12) - 3(8)] + [8(-24) - 3(0)] = 12 Dy - 72 - 192 = 0 -> Dy = 22 kN up; SigmaFy = 0 -> Ay = 14 kN up; SigmaFx = 0 -> Ax = 8 kN to the LEFT. Distinguishing feature bites: the truss carries nine members and none appears on the external diagram, so including any of them would be visibly wrong; the horizontal applied load makes Ax genuinely nonzero so SigmaFx does real work rather than resolving trivially; and the loads sit 3 m above the support line so the horizontal force carries a real moment arm and the arm choice is decisive. HONEST LIMITATION recorded in concept, procedure, solution and common_errors - the sharp point of this skill: a moment check taken about the OTHER SUPPORT is blind to two of the three reactions. The far support's own reaction has zero moment arm about itself, and a horizontal reaction at a support collinear with the check point also has zero arm; a check about D closes for Dy = 21, for Ax = +8 with the wrong sign, and for Ax = 0 omitted, detecting only an error in Ay. VERIFICATION PRECEDES REPORT in both arrays (verify at index 5, report at index 6), and the verification is taken about joint C(8,3), a point OFF the support line, which detects all three: load at B (-4)(-12) - (0)(8) = 48, reaction A (-8)(14) - (-3)(-8) = -136, reaction D (4)(22) - (-3)(0) = 88, SigmaM_C = 48 - 136 + 88 = 0. This is the second skill in recent batches where the conventional check is the one that fails, after position_vector_3d's sign-blind magnitude, and the artifact states plainly what the conventional check misses and why. THREE-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 2 (external FBD contents and assumed senses - placing a member force on the external diagram, omitting a reaction component especially Ax when a horizontal load is present, or assigning an inconsistent assumed sense), axis_confusion at step 3 (moment-arm pairing - the arm of a vertical force is the horizontal coordinate distance and the arm of a horizontal force is the vertical distance; its trigger opens by stipulating correct FBD contents, which cleanly partitions it from step 2 rather than duplicating the crux), unclassified at step 7 (report and boundary - incomplete reaction set, treating a moment check about the other support as sufficient, skipped off-line verification, or proceeding into member forces, zero-force members or tension/compression signs). solution_sequencing_error OMITTED with explicit argument: the three equilibrium equations form a solvable set and no authored step strands a prerequisite unknown; choosing a moment point that isolates one unknown is an efficiency choice, not a stranding. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Trig-resolution cross-check N/A recorded affirmatively: loads are given as components and no inclined vector is decomposed. No archetype is asserted while PROCEDURE-ARCHETYPE-LIBRARY-V1 remains unapproved. One correction lane preceded sign-off: CORRECTION-001 appended five entries to formula.variables (M, x, y, Fx, Fy) which appear in formula.notation but were undeclared, bringing the set to 8; it was a pure append with every other field byte-identical, and the gap arose because the Operator's symbol instruction listed which symbols to use without restating the declaration requirement. Opens Batch 4J; unlocks method_of_joints and method_of_sections.
